name: Cyhyreath

attributes.attribute: sends the reader to the Caointeach entry

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Cyhyreath is a term that holds no separate account of its own. Its one entry sends the reader to another heading. That heading is the entry for Caointeach.

okr.objective: Cyhyreath is a cross reference that leads to Caointeach.
key_results: Cyhyreath carries no separate account of its own.
